metadata.title: Studio Review
metadata.description: A guide to the Studio review feature for partners.

home.title: Studio Review
home.description: A demo app that walks you through the Studio review flow in three steps: pick a collection, pick a job, then review it.

continue.title: Continue reviewing
continue.empty: None of the jobs opened in this browser are in review.

recent.title: Recent reviews
recent.hint: Review records from everyone using this server. Jobs not opened in this browser show their IDs.
recent.failed: Couldn't load review status, so only jobs opened in this browser are shown.

collections.title: Pick a collection
collections.description: Choose the document collection you want to review.

items.0: Filter by source, and choose which columns to show
items.3: Copy the collection ID with the button next to the name

detail.title: Pick a job
detail.description: Choose a completed job to review.

items.0: Check file name, size, review status and config
items.1: Search by file name, or open a job directly by its ID
items.2: Filter by review status and review jobs in order
items.3: See a notice for collections that do not support review

job.title: Review the job
job.description: Compare with the original pages, fix the document structure and values, then save.

items.0: Highlight parsed content and extracted values on page images
items.1: Split, merge, move, reorder, exclude and label documents
items.2: Find documents flagged by validation and empty values right away
items.3: Save and mark reviewed in one step, then move to the next job

settings.label: Settings
settings.stepsHint: Only the steps turned on here appear as tabs in every job. Parse and Instruct are read only.
settings.advance: Open the next job after completing
settings.advanceHint: When you complete a job opened with "Review in order", the next job opens right away.

groupHints.pageEditing: Split or merge documents and move pages. Keep these off for a cleaner screen when you only check labels.
groupHints.advanced: Work with the review result as a file or look back at saved changes.

featureHint.pageTools: Shows boundary navigation, Split here, To previous, To next, Exclude page and Move pages on the structure toolbar, and Exclude document and Split into a new document in the panel.
featureHint.filmstrip: On the structure tab, browse neighboring documents' pages as a strip and pick where to split.
featureHint.organizer: See every document's pages in a grid, move, exclude, or split several into a new document at once, and split a document with ✂ between thumbnails.
featureHint.jsonMenu: Adds a JSON menu to the header to download or edit the review result.
featureHint.history: Shows a change history button in the header. Use it to load a previously saved value or the original back in.
